import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { useSelector, useDispatch } from 'react-redux'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { PlusIcon, MagnifyingGlassIcon, FunnelIcon, EyeIcon, PencilIcon, TrashIcon, ClockIcon, UserGroupIcon, CheckCircleIcon, XCircleIcon, BriefcaseIcon, CurrencyDollarIcon, DocumentTextIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline'; import Button from '../../components/ui/Button'; import Badge from '../../components/ui/Badge'; import MobileNav from '../../components/layout/MobileNav'; const MyTasks = () => { const navigate = useNavigate(); const { user } = useSelector((state) => state.auth); const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([ { id: 1, title: 'Data Entry - Customer Records', description: 'Enter customer information from scanned documents into our database system.', category: 'Data Entry', status: 'active', budget: 150, submissions: 15, approved: 12, rejected: 2, pending: 1, workers: 8, createdDate: '2024-03-15', deadline: '2024-03-25', completionRate: 80 }, { id: 2, title: 'Image Classification Project', description: 'Classify product images into appropriate categories for our e-commerce platform.', category: 'AI/ML', status: 'active', budget: 500, submissions: 8, approved: 6, rejected: 1, pending: 1, workers: 5, createdDate: '2024-03-18', deadline: '2024-03-30', completionRate: 75 }, { id: 3, title: 'Survey Completion', description: 'Complete market research survey about consumer preferences.', category: 'Survey', status: 'completed', budget: 75, submissions: 50, approved: 48, rejected: 2, pending: 0, workers: 25, createdDate: '2024-03-10', deadline: '2024-03-20', completionRate: 100 }, { id: 4, title: 'Content Moderation', description: 'Review and moderate user-generated content for policy violations.', category: 'Moderation', status: 'paused', budget: 200, submissions: 12, approved: 8, rejected: 3, pending: 1, workers: 6, createdDate: '2024-03-12', deadline: '2024-03-22', completionRate: 60 } ]); const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState(''); const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('all'); const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState('all'); const filteredTasks = tasks.filter(task => { const matchesSearch = task.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || task.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()); const matchesStatus = filterStatus === 'all' || task.status === filterStatus; const matchesCategory = filterCategory === 'all' || task.category === filterCategory; return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesCategory; }); const getStatusBadge = (status) => { switch (status) { case 'active': return Active; case 'completed': return Completed; case 'paused': return Paused; case 'cancelled': return Cancelled; default: return {status}; } }; const handleTaskAction = (taskId, action) => { switch (action) { case 'view': // Navigate to task detail page break; case 'edit': // Navigate to edit task page break; case 'pause': setTasks(tasks.map(task => task.id === taskId ? { ...task, status: 'paused' } : task )); break; case 'resume': setTasks(tasks.map(task => task.id === taskId ? { ...task, status: 'active' } : task )); break; case 'delete': setTasks(tasks.filter(task => task.id !== taskId)); break; default: break; } }; const totalBudget = tasks.reduce((sum, task) => sum + task.budget, 0); const activeTasks = tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'active').length; const totalSubmissions = tasks.reduce((sum, task) => sum + task.submissions, 0); return (
